title: Scriptorium Library KB v1
description: Canonical machine-readable snapshot of a reference library (produced by Steward `export`, consumed by Provenance and tolerant agents/tools). Consumers MUST ignore and preserve unknown fields.

schema_version.description: Format identifier and version, e.g. "library-kb/1.0" or "library-kb/1.1". Minor 1.1 adds the optional citekey field; 1.0 remains valid. Major bump = breaking, minor bump = additive.

key.description: Zotero item key (stable identifier within a library).

citekey.description: Better BibTeX citation key (from the item's extra field `Citation Key:` line); empty when unset. The universal cross-system join — keys reading-note/1.0 and resolves `[[citekey]]` wikilinks to the library note. Optional and introduced in library-kb/1.1. Consumers remain tolerant of historical 1.0 payloads that already carry it.

authors.description: Last names (or full names for institutional authors), in original order.

year.description: 4-digit publication year, or empty string when unknown.

itemType.description: Zotero item type, e.g. journalArticle, thesis, book.

folders.description: Collection paths, '/'-separated from the top level, e.g. "01_ML/Core".

tags.description: All tags verbatim, including ai:-prefixed machine tags.

aiTags.description: Machine tags with the ai: prefix stripped. Derived from `tags`; producers SHOULD keep both consistent.

tldr.description: One-sentence summary, extracted from the item's extra field `TLDR:` line.

readStatus.description: zotero-reading-list status (extra field `Read_Status:` line); empty when unset.

pdfPaths.description: Absolute local paths to PDF attachments. Machine-specific; consumers MUST NOT assume they exist.
